# Junto Technologies

> Junto Technologies modernizes chemistry labs. It also applies machine learning and statistics to biomedical questions.

## Projects

- [ChemInventory](https://cheminventory.co/): Chemical inventory that fits how each lab works.
- [Bench Bridge](https://bench-bridge.juntotechnologies.com/): A demo of how older lab instruments feed a LIMS and a controlled-substance ledger.

## Open source

- [dcurves](https://github.com/MSKCC-Epi-Bio/dcurves): A Python package for decision curve analysis. It measures model performance with clinical consequences in mind.
- [bioeq](https://github.com/juntotechnologies/bioeq): A Python package for bioequivalence analysis. It handles 2x2 crossover, parallel and replicate designs.
- [hct-equity](https://github.com/juntotechnologies/hct-equity): Compares survival predictions across race groups, with calibration and decision curves. Uses synthetic Kaggle data. Not peer reviewed.
